fit_full: Live arrival times and live bus positions: each bus moves along its route on the board as it reports where it is, and the minutes count down to your stop.
fit_arrivals: Live arrival times, counting down to your stop. Buses here don't share their positions, so the board shows the minutes without moving buses on the route.
source_p: Straight from the open data published by {source}. My Bus Stop is an independent app; it isn't made or endorsed by any transit agency or operator.
web_p: On a computer? Open My Bus Stop on the web, free and with no download.
faq_official_q: Is this an official transit app?
faq_official_a: No. My Bus Stop is an independent app. It shows the open data published by {source}, and isn't made or endorsed by any transit agency or operator.
faq_web_q: Can I use it on a computer?
faq_web_a: Yes. Open My Bus Stop on the web in any browser, free and with no sign-up. The app adds wall mode, widgets, Apple Watch and Apple TV.
other_h2: Live bus times in other cities
